intro.h2: Pick your slab, then C&M cuts and installs it
paragraphs: C&M Cabinets and Granite fabricates and installs granite countertops in Collierville, and the stone is right there to see. The company has so much inventory it added a new warehouse to hold it all, with rows of granite, natural stone and quartz slabs.

That selection is what Google's review summary picks out: any stone, any color, in one place. C&M also designs and supplies custom and imported cabinets, so cabinets and tops can come from one company. One customer had his quartz countertops installed right after his new cabinets went in. Saturday morning hours make it easy to come and look.

items.name: Granite and stone countertops
items.blurb: Granite and other natural stone fabricated for kitchens and islands. Choose from bold exotic slabs with black, white and gold movement or quieter whites and grays, then C&M cuts and installs them in your home.

image.alt: Exotic granite slab with black, white and gold swirls standing in the C&M slab yard

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Quartz countertops for kitchens and baths, measured, fabricated and installed by C&M. A Google reviewer said Ricky and his crew did an amazing job installing his quartz tops once the new cabinets were in, and that he couldn't be happier.

image.alt: Rows of white veined countertop slabs lined up inside the C&M warehouse

items.name: Custom and imported cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinet design with custom and imported cabinetry, from painted kitchen runs to black glass-front built-ins with brass hardware and lit shelves. C&M describes itself on Facebook as a stone fabricator and cabinet design firm, so the cabinets and the stone are planned together.

image.alt: Black glass-front built-in cabinets with brass pulls, lit shelves and a stone countertop

items.name: Bathroom vanities
items.blurb: Vanity cabinets and stone tops for bathrooms, like a long double vanity in greige shaker cabinets with a white quartz top and two sinks. Cabinet replacement and quick turnaround are recurring topics in C&M's Google reviews.

image.alt: Double bathroom vanity with greige shaker cabinets, a white quartz top, two sinks and black-framed mirrors

why_choose_us.h2: Why Mid South homeowners come to C&M

items.title: A huge selection
items.text: "Huge selection, great staff to work with," says one review highlighted by Google. Walk the indoor warehouse and the outdoor slab yard and see the real stone first.

items.title: Cabinets and tops together
items.text: C&M designs and supplies cabinets and fabricates the countertops, so one company plans both and the tops can go in right after the cabinets.

items.title: Quick turnaround
items.text: Google tags three of C&M's 37 reviews for quick turnaround, and others for caring staff and cabinet replacement, so customers notice how fast the work moves.

items.title: Named people, not a call center
items.text: Customers name installer Ricky and his crew. C&M has also introduced its designer Tricia Lichtle and installer Christopher Kelley on Facebook.

about.text: C&M Cabinets and Granite is a stone fabricator and cabinet design firm at 320 S Mt Pleasant Rd in Collierville, Tennessee. It offers quality custom and imported cabinetry plus granite fabrication and installation to customers in Collierville and the tri-state area. Inventory grew enough that the company added a new warehouse to hold it all. The team has included designer Tricia Lichtle and installer Christopher Kelley, and reviewers praise Ricky and crew. C&M is also listed in the West Tennessee Home Builders Association member directory.

image.alt: Outdoor slab yard with rows of granite and natural stone slabs on racks under trees

process.h2: From slab yard to installed countertops

steps.title: Visit the warehouse
steps.text: Stop by 320 S Mt Pleasant Rd, Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM or Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, and walk the slabs.

steps.title: In-house estimate
steps.text: C&M has offered free in-house estimates. Call (901) 854-7007 to set one up and confirm the details.

steps.title: Design cabinets and choose stone
steps.text: Work out your cabinet layout and pick the exact slab you want for your kitchen, bath or bar.

steps.title: Fabricate and install
steps.text: Your stone is fabricated and installed, and if new cabinets are part of the job, the tops go in after the cabinets.

steps.title: Check it over
steps.text: Walk through the finished job with the installer, and point out anything you want checked before they leave.

service_area.h2: Granite countertops in Collierville and the tri-state area
service_area.text: C&M Cabinets and Granite is at 320 S Mt Pleasant Rd in Collierville, Tennessee. Its Instagram profile says it serves customers in Collierville and the tri-state area, and one reviewer calls it the best place for cabinets and granite in the Mid South. Call (901) 854-7007 to confirm that your home is in their install area, or stop by the warehouse.

items.q: Can I pick my own slab?
items.a: Yes. C&M keeps a large inventory of granite, natural stone and quartz slabs at 320 S Mt Pleasant Rd and added a new warehouse to hold it all. Google reviewers single out the huge selection and say that whatever stone and color you want, you can find it there.

Yes. C&M offers custom and imported cabinetry and describes itself as a stone fabricator and cabinet design firm. A Google reviewer had new cabinets installed and then his quartz countertops put in by Ricky and crew, all through C&M, so you deal with one company for both.

C&M has advertised free in-house estimates on its Facebook page. Call (901) 854-7007 to confirm how estimates work today and to book a visit. Bring rough measurements or photos of your kitchen or bath to the warehouse so the team can help with slab choice.

Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. Closed on Sunday. You can also email cm.cabinets@att.net with your project details, your measurements or the slab you saw, and the team will follow up with you.

C&M is based in Collierville, Tennessee, and its Instagram profile says it serves Collierville and the tri-state area. A Google reviewer calls it the best place for cabinets and granite in the Mid South. Call to check that your address is within their install range.

final_cta.text: Call C&M or stop by the Collierville warehouse to start your countertops.
